name: gjc-plugin
description: gajae-code plugin distribution repo (workspace-standard plugin-ts profile root).

scripts.build: bun run build:advisor && bun run build:verification && bun run build:ui && bun run build:wiki && bun run build:rea && bun run build:backplan && bun run build:rrsi && bun run build:aside-memory
scripts.build:check: bun jev-advisor/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun verification-receipts/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun ui-regression/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun wiki/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun rea/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun backplan/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun rrsi/scripts/build.mjs --check && bun aside-memory/scripts/build.mjs --check
scripts.hermes:test: cd integrations/hermes/jev-gate && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.test:rrsi: bun rrsi/scripts/verify.ts && bun test rrsi/tests/readme-contract.test.ts rrsi/tests/quality-cohort.test.ts && node --test rrsi/tests/periodic.test.mjs
